sample_unit: true/false clinical assertions (HealthBench-BR); plus 890 open-ended questions (PCDT-QA)

links.outcome: LLM knowledge of official Brazilian clinical guideline content on true/false and open-ended questions
links.effect: Current LLMs perform poorly on guideline-specific knowledge; the adapted 14B model reached 83.9% on HealthBench-BR and 85.4% on PCDT-QA, outperforming GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Google AI Overview.
links.quote: Yet current LLMs perform poorly on this guideline-specific knowledge, and no benchmark evaluates clinical recall grounded in Brazilian Portuguese protocols.

unlisted_practices: Continual pre-training on synthetic data derived from official clinical guidelines followed by GRPO reinforcement learning to inject national guideline knowledge into a small open LLM
Using multiple diverse generator LLMs for synthetic training data

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (specifically a domain-adapted Qwen model and baselines) on newly introduced Brazilian clinical guideline benchmarks (HealthBench-BR and PCDT-QA).
